# Three-chart analytic normal sweep

The isolated commit is `813d81ff66364c0286bea86f3891669da70e6db1`. The portable patch SHA-256 is `faf540b91b4b072801d9329b307bded2b9a6764ef0769c4bdc6344faf20ad4bf`. Its prerequisite is the independently qualified oblique two-chart proof.

Two independently sealed pair certificates must refer to the identical original middle sweep and to two opposite original middle edges. The proof compares the two nonzero exact plane covectors by a nonzero rational scale, transforms the second constant and halfspace sign into the first scale, and checks the strict ordering of both planes and both side assignments. The two closed outer halfspaces have a positive projection gap at every displacement. The union therefore has exactly the two original shared walls and no end-chart contact. The returned original source boundary has fourteen analytic faces with original owner IDs and inherited outward orientations. The two original join maps and plane scales remain separately inspectable.

The source places three exact original cells of the graph `z=[(x-5/8)(x-13/8)]²/512+y²/64` using the qualified two-axis rational rotation and translation from the oblique-pair evidence. The middle chart has its own reversed Möbius free station and uses opposing V walls. The normal displacement remains `[-1/11,2/13]`. The first covector is `(48,36,-25)/7`; the second is the negative `3/2` rescaling. The raw plane constants are `477/112` and `-4551/224` and the end-chart projection gap in the first scale is `65/7`. Composition after the pair proofs costs 14 exact operations. The source fixture checks both common wall positions at exact original raw stations and checks outer owner positions at unequal displacements.

The descending planar control mixes the Cartesian option and a sparse covector, and its separate exact material integrals sum to `3/5`. Negative cases are independently embedded and independently pairwise joined. They exercise a folded middle wall whose two end charts actually overlap, a distinct instance of the middle chart, and nonparallel separating planes on opposite middle edges. Insufficient work and cancellation return no chain or gap.

Focused pair and chain tests passed in 2.000 seconds and under the race detector in 7.085 seconds. The full geometry, mesh and offset suites passed in 39.204, 7.415 and 25.915 seconds. The separate tessellation increment is tracked independently.
